- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Pet Save Safety Sign-In Copy: Update sign-in headline and body to clearly inform returning users that their saved pets and pet state are automatically preserved in cloud storage upon sign-in. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and past learnings show copy changes on sign_in consistently win (+2.0% avg).)
1: [sign_in, copy] Pet Restoration Guarantee Sign-In Copy: Revise sign-in screen body copy to promise immediate automatic pet recovery across devices. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing pet profiles after logging back in; sign_in copy tweaks are proven effective (+2.0% average gain).)
2: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Pet Creation Redesign: Redesign the companion selection step using a spotlight layout to give users a focused view of available pet options. (why: Adoption stage experiences high median completion time (89s) and dropoff (83.7% conversion). Lessons indicate redesign changes in adoption yield positive conversion gains (+1.4%).)
3: [adoption, redesign] Full Bleed Photo Customizer Redesign: Redesign photo upload customizer screen using a full-bleed visual layout with step guidance. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted failures or visual glitches in custom pet creation. Redesigning adoption screens is a proven strategy (+1.4% gain).)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Step Counter Wait Info: Display a clear step counter and initialization message on the waiting screen while desktop pet engine assets load. (why: Home stage has high median wait time (201s) and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop. Wait_info changes on home consistently show positive gains (+1.6%).)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Ready Notification Wait Info: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts and tip carousel delays on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Users spend up to 201s median in waiting screen, causing dropoff. Wait_info changes on home yield positive results (+1.6% average).)
6: [choose_path, redesign] Two-Column Path Choice Redesign: Rebuild the choose_path screen into a two-column layout highlighting quick starter vs custom pet creation paths. (why: Choose_path redesign changes showed consistent improvements (+2.2% average). Clearer path differentiation reduces decision time (mean 514s).)
7: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Review Screen: Insert a dedicated pre-adoption summary screen where users verify their pet's name and visual features before confirming adoption. (why: Support reported 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong. A verification screen lets users catch errors before final certificate creation.)
8: [sign_in, hint] Companion Cloud Sync Hint: Add an explicit helper hint below the sign-in options explaining that signing in restores existing pets and cloud saves. (why: 8 users emailed support about missing or reset pets after logging in again; sign_in copy/hint tweaks win 5/9 tests (+2.0% avg).)
9: [home, wait_info] Engine Setup Progress Wait Info: Show a real-time progress bar indicator and estimated remaining setup time on the waiting screen. (why: Median wait time in home initialization stage is 201s with 88.3% step conversion. Wait_info improvements have proven effective (+1.6% avg).)
